name: dsh-vision-insights-plugin
description: LinkHealth Vision Insights for DeepSeek Harness: DSH-side access point for vision insights. The OpenVINO visual app (Intelligent Queue Management kit) is a separate application with its own insight storage (SQLite behind a thin read API); this plugin's query_vision_events tool reads that data source via a baseUrl config entry — deterministic facts, LLM narrates.
